subject: Fastest air freight option to GRU
body:
Hi there,

Hope your week’s going well! Could you send me an all-in quote in EUR for the fastest air freight option to GRU (Sao Paulo, BR), including pickup at our site in 60328 (Frankfurt am Main), Germany, and the truck you’ll arrange to the airport?

The shipment is laboratory glassware: 5 pieces, with a gross weight of 1633 kg and a volume of 13.79 cbm. It’ll be ready for pickup on 2026-11-27.

Could you also let me know the earliest arrival you can offer at GRU?

Thanks for checking!

Cheers,
Klaus Weidner
Weidner Spielwaren GmbH, Nuremberg
